messages:
Clare (ACME): Hi — we accepted the free-trial grant this morning but our Dedicated pool never provisioned. Console shows a grant attached to our Private tenant instead. Can someone look?
Ashley (Support): Sorry about that, Clare. Can you paste the Grant ID you see in the console? I can start an audit.
Clare (ACME): grant_2026_free_ACME_01. UI says 'Applied to: ACME-private-vpc' not 'ACME-dedicated-prod'.
Ashley (Support): thx. tagging @Samir for billing/allocations and @Miguel for infra.
Miguel (SRE): Quick check — provisioning fails if grant namespace is tied to a private tenant id. Do you have the tenant_id?
Clare (ACME): tenant id in UI: tnt-acme-08. The dedicated request was for tenant tnt-acme-dedicated. We did a self-serve request for dedicated and included that tenant in the form.
Samir (Billing): Grant-bot audit coming. @grant-bot show-grant grant_2026_free_ACME_01
grant-bot: Audit output — Grant: grant_2026_free_ACME_01 | Amount: 5000 tokens | AppliedTo: tnt-acme-08 | SKU: dedicated-standard | CreatedBy: marketing@partner-campaign | CreatedAt: 1712359000
Ashley (Support): Interesting — SKU is dedicated-standard but AppliedTo is the private tenant. Looks like a target-tenant mismatch at allocation time.
Miguel (SRE): Repro steps I'd try: 1) call GET /v1/grants/{id} 2) verify tenant_id vs provisioning request 3) attempt reassign via internal tool.
Ashley (Support): Clare, can you paste the API response from GET /v1/grants/grant_2026_free_ACME_01 if you have access? If not we can do it from Support.
Clare (ACME): I don't have API access to grants. Please go ahead.
Ashley (Support): Ok doing GET (internal). ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/grants/grant_2026_free_ACME_01```
Ashley (Support): Response: ```{
  "id": "grant_2026_free_ACME_01",
  "applied_to": "tnt-acme-08",
  "sku": "dedicated-standard",
  "status": "active"
}```
Samir (Billing): Since sku==dedicated-standard but applied_to==private tenant, this is an allocation routing bug in the grant pipeline. We can do a manual reassignment for this customer to unblock provisioning. Need approval from Finance for manual rebind?
Ashley (Support): Clare — if we reassign the grant to tnt-acme-dedicated will that resolve the Dedicated provisioning immediately?
Clare (ACME): Yes — once the grant is scoped to the dedicated tenant the UI should kick off allocation and we can provision. We can't do it ourselves because private tenant is locked down.
Miguel (SRE): I'll put a temporary hold and run the reassignment once Billing confirms. Note: if there are existing resources in tnt-acme-08 that consumed partial tokens we should snapshot usage.
Samir (Billing): Confirmed. I see no consumption on that grant in the audit logs. Finance approves a one-off manual rebind. I'll issue an internal ticket: FIN-ALLOC-629.
Ashley (Support): Proceeding with rebind now. ```POST /internal/admin/grants/rebind { "grant_id":"grant_2026_free_ACME_01", "target_tenant":"tnt-acme-dedicated" }```
grant-bot: Rebind queued: job_98742 | status: queued | requested_by: ashley@redwood.ai
Miguel (SRE): Watching job_98742. If it finishes, I'll trigger the dedicated provisioner.
grant-bot: Job update job_98742 | status: running
grant-bot: Job update job_98742 | status: success | applied_to: tnt-acme-dedicated
Ashley (Support): Rebind succeeded. Confirming grant now shows applied_to tnt-acme-dedicated.
Clare (ACME): I see it in the UI now as dedicated. Provisioning started. Thanks! :tada:
Miguel (SRE): Dedicated pool provisioning kicked off — initial nodes attaching, ETA ~6m.
Samir (Billing): Logging this for postmortem. Root cause looks like a misrouted allocation from partner campaign handler where tenant mapping used 'primary_tenant' (private) instead of 'requested_tenant' (dedicated). We'll add a validation step.
Ashley (Support): Clare — closing the support ticket once you confirm Dedicated is fully active.
Clare (ACME): Confirmed — Dedicated pool active and endpoints responding. All good. Thanks for the fast follow-up.
Samir (Billing): Action items: (1) add allocation sanity check in pipeline (2) postmortem doc FIN-ALLOC-629 (3) contact partner ops to patch mapping.
Miguel (SRE): I'll create infra task to emit an alert if grant.sku != tenant.type during ingestion.
Ashley (Support): Noted. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:"
